entities.summary: Ghulam Ahmad Parwez was a Pakistani Islamic scholar and qāriʾ. He posed a challenge to the established Sunni doctrine by interpreting Quranic themes with a logical approach. The work 'Islam: A Challenge to Religion' is widely acknowledged as one of the most significant works in the history of Pakistan, according to Nadeem F. Paracha.
